map.Th=600+273=873 K、Tc=30+273=303 K：η_carno: Th=600+273=873 K, Tc=30+273=303 K: η_carnot=1−303/873≈65.3%. Actual supercritical units are about 45%-47%, below the Carnot limit due to irreversible losses. Tip: raising Th (higher steam parameters) is the main path to improving efficiency.
map.卡诺效率能实现吗？: Can the Carnot efficiency be achieved?
map.不能，是理想可逆循环上限；实际循环效率必低于它，用来判断改进空间。: No, it is the ideal reversible cycle upper limit; actual cycle efficiency must be below it, and it is used to judge the room for improvement.
map.为什么提高热源温度最有效？: Why is raising the heat source temperature most effective?
map.η 随 Th 升高单调上升、对 Tc 下降敏感，因此超临界/二次再热等提参数技术: η rises monotonically with Th and is sensitive to a decrease in Tc, so parameter-raising technologies such as supercritical/double reheat have long dominated thermal power efficiency improvements.
map.卡诺效率：η = 1 − T_c ÷ T_h（热力学温标 K）；联动卡：温差 =: Carnot efficiency: η = 1 − T_c ÷ T_h (thermodynamic scale, K); related cards: temperature difference = T_h − T_c (K), cold/hot ratio = T_c ÷ T_h (requires T_c < T_h), heat-rejection ratio = 1 − η. Validation: T_c must be ≥ 0, T_h > 0 and T_c < T_h; otherwise an error is shown and the calculation stops (preventing negative efficiency when Celsius values are entered or the two temperatures are swapped). Criteria: no fixed grades; η is the reversible-engine limit between the two temperatures and grows as T_c falls and T_h rises.
map.低温 T_c 须 ≥0 且小于高温 T_h（单位 K）；请确认未误填摄氏温度或高: The cold temperature T_c must be ≥ 0 and lower than the hot temperature T_h (in K); check that Celsius values were not entered and the two temperatures are not swapped.
